SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM cooking_task t WHERE t.dish_id = d.id AND t.status = 'COMPLETED') AS usage_count FROM dish d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MAX(t.create_time) AS last_used FROM cooking_task t WHERE t.dish_id = d.id AND t.org_unit_id = d.org_unit_id AND (t.submitter_id = #{recentUserId} OR t.chef_id = #{recentUserId}) ) u ON TRUE
WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY u.last_used DESC NULLS LAST, d.last_modify_time DESC
ORDER BY d.last_modify_time DESC, d.create_time DESC
